channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Tomoka Christian Church welcomes hundreds for 2026 Night to Shine celebration
item.description: More than 600 volunteers, 480 VIP guests and nearly 800 parents and caregivers took part in the global event sponsored by the Tim Tebow Foundation in Ormond Beach.

item.title: Ormond Beach Police honors 2025 Officer, Civilian of the Year
item.description: Jake Sesemann was named Officer of the Year. Crime Scene Analyst CeCe Woody was named Civilian of the Year.

item.title: Volusia County Sheriff Chitwood rescinds endorsement of Rep. Fine
item.description: 'As Sheriff, my job is to protect everyone,' Chitwood wrote on social media. Fine has made several controversial comments on social media over the last week about Muslims.

item.title: Seabreeze looking for new girls and boys team soccer coaches
item.description: Girls coach Eli Freidus stepped down. Boys coach Alex Perez was let go.

item.title: Lakewood Senior Housing, a Volusia County Transform386 project, breaks ground in Daytona
item.description: Located at 1300 Jimmy Ann Drive in Daytona Beach, the project will provide 56 affordable housing units for income-qualified seniors.

item.title: Pair catches 10-foot tiger shark from the beach in the Flagler/Ormond area
item.description: Ash Perdue and Ayden Rogers were about to reel it in after several hours when their line took off.

item.title: Civic League of the Halifax Area installs 2026 board, recognizes award recipients
item.description: Outgoing Chair Nancy Lohman passed the gavel to incoming chair Chris Tolland.

item.title: John Anderson Drive home sells for $2.2M in Ormond Beach
item.description: Built in 1964, the house is a 7/5.5 and has two fireplaces, a pool, an outdoor kitchen, a boat dock, a boat lift, a boat house and 7,092 square feet.

item.title: Fast times, perfect weather at Flagler Palm Coast's 22nd annual East Coast Classic track and field meet
item.description: Sprinters lead the way for second-place FPC boys team.

item.title: Community Mourns as Missing Palm Coast Teen Dies in Train Tragedy
item.description: 16-year-old Khalon Pierre had been reported missing before deputies identified him following a train incident in Bunnell, according to the Flagler County Sheriff’s Office.
